title: Dromo S NDE 2718
content: I was in deep and complete unconsciousness. I felt that there is a woman near my head in white dress taking caring of me. When I woke up, I thought she was the nurse. I wanted to thank her, but the people around me told me there was nobody around me. When I asked the priest, he told me that the woman was the Virgin Mary. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 23_10 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Illness Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Frightening Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I am not sure. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I heard a voice ask God to heal me. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Very bright light talked with me, but I don't remember what he talked about. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place نعم رايت نفسي في مكان كله خضار بيئه نظيفه شلالات اناس جيدون ل وجع ولا موت What emotions did you feel during the experience? When I was in an operation room, when they took me out, I was unconscious. I felt there was some spirit flying above my head and a very hard press on my chest, my right foot raised up, and I felt a severe pain in my big toe, as if something was coming out of it. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Neither Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I became closer in my relations with the people. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I thought how I faced death, and the vision I saw was that as if I am a flying angel in white dress, I saw myself in the paradise, very hard to explain. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I told my mother, she was surprised. I told the priest, he told me that I was in a paradise and the faults and sins were getting out from me, and also I told the sheikh. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was probably real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt a spirit flying above his head; a very hard press on his chest; right foot raised up; severe pain in big toe as if something was coming out of it; reported losing awareness of his body.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Virgin Mary (identified by a priest after the experience).
arrival.other_being_detail: A very bright light that 'talked with me, but I don't remember what he talked about.' Also described a 'woman near my head in white dress' caring for him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Arabic description: 'a place all green, clean environment, waterfalls, good people, no pain and no death.' Also described as an unfamiliar/strange place.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Unconscious during an operation; illness/condition stated as not considered life-threatening.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Not specified; references to priest and sheikh.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard a voice asking God to heal him; later told by a priest that faults/sins were getting out from him.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported unconsciousness/operation context, sensing a presence and bodily sensations, then awareness of a woman in white caring for him and a very bright light, plus a strange green place with waterfalls.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Strong physical sensations during unconsciousness: hard pressure on chest; right foot raised; severe pain in big toe 'as if something was coming out of it.' Priest interpreted as faults/sins leaving him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I heard a voice ask God to heal me.” / “Very bright light talked with me, but I don't remember what he talked about.” / “I saw myself in the paradise, very hard to explain.” / Arabic: “نعم رايت نفسي في مكان كله خضار بيئه نظيفه شلالات اناس جيدون ل وجع ولا موت”
